name: Kinisi KR1
summary: KR1 is a wheeled two-arm humanoid from Kinisi Robotics for picking, placing and sorting in warehouses and factories. It is reported to carry 10 kg, reach 2.4 m/s and run 6-8 hours on hot-swappable batteries. Bear Robotics agreed to acquire Kinisi in June 2026 and presents the robot as an upcoming product.
highlights: 48 V hot-swappable lithium-ion battery and auto-docking.
Bear Robotics signed an agreement to acquire Kinisi on 22 June 2026.
caveats: Height, weight and DoF come from a third-party database, not an official spec sheet.
Bear lists payload and reach as to be confirmed at launch.
